transport: remote Streamable HTTP via npx mcp-remote

get_mix_and_match.description: Build a complete, multi-item Mix & Match outfit widget — several coordinated looks, each with multiple garments styled together. Use this when the shopper wants a full outfit or styling help, NOT a specific named item. Three modes are supported: anchor_sku, query, and context_image_ref; query takes precedence if both query and anchor_sku are provided. At least one of anchor_sku, query, or context_image_ref must be supplied.

anchor_sku.description: SKU of the anchor product to build outfits around, for anchor mode. Required field — pass an empty string "" if not applicable.

query.description: Semantic styling request, e.g. 'casual summer outfit for a beach day' or 'smart-casual look for a business dinner'. Required field — pass an empty string "" if not applicable.

context_image_ref.description: ref_id returned by request_context_image. Required field — pass an empty string "" if not applicable.

country.description: ISO country code the shopper is buying in, e.g. 'IN', 'US'. Defaults to 'IN'.

gender.description: Gender of the products to search for. This is a catalog filter — NOT the user's own gender.

caption.description: Optional widget headline. Defaults to 'Ways to style <name>' or 'Outfits for <query>'.

tenant_id.description: Optional tenant identifier forwarded to catalog search as context.tenant_id.

search_fashion_products.description: The go-to tool for ANY fashion, apparel, or styling request. Searches Glance's fashion catalog and renders results directly as an interactive browsable carousel in one call.

gender.description: Gender of the products to search for. This is a catalog filter — NOT the user's own gender.

country.description: ISO country code for regional catalog, e.g. 'IN', 'US'.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code matching the country — e.g. 'INR' for IN, 'USD' for US.

query.description: Natural-language query. Required — pass an empty string when not applicable.

header.description: Short user-facing headline for this result row.

context_summary.description: Contextual summary for search relevance. Required — pass an empty string when not applicable.

context_image_ref.description: Ref ID from request_context_image. Required — pass an empty string when not applicable.

smoke_call.request_description: Suggest a smart-casual outfit with a white shirt, including a complementary bottom and footwear.
